invariant: In an allowmixing class diagram, an entity's SVG group metadata is owned by the concrete SVEK entity-image implementation, not inferred uniformly from the parser's source location. UGroup emits DATA_SOURCE_LINE only when its constructor receives a non-null LineLocation. EntityImageClass, EntityImageObject, and EntityImageDescription construct their groups with entity.getLocation(), so class-like entities, objects, and description symbols such as circles carry source-line metadata. EntityImageState and EntityImageBranch construct location-free groups, so mixed states and branch/state-choice diamonds omit data-source-line even though their entities retain source locations for parsing, ordering, and relationships.
causal_divergence: Rust's no-oracle class renderer creates one common entity group wrapper before dispatching the body painter by EntityKind. The first correction changed its fallback from every entity to every non-state entity. That fixed mixed state groups but still serialized EntityDims.source_line for EntityKind::Diamond, even though GeneralImageBuilder selects EntityImageBranch and that painter creates a location-free group. The divergence is therefore concrete renderer-image metadata ownership, not a state/non-state dichotomy, type dispatch, parser location tracking, graph layout, or source-line numbering.
planned_change: Keep source_line on ClassEntity and EntityDims so ordering and relationship logic remain unchanged. Add a single EntityKind image-contract predicate for no-oracle source-line metadata: class-like kinds, EntityKind::Object, and EntityKind::Circle carry a LineLocation; EntityKind::State and EntityKind::Diamond do not. Preserve oracle-provided source-line metadata if present, because the oracle-assisted path must reproduce supplied SVG metadata. Extend renderer tests with the rejected branch/diamond heldout while retaining state negative controls and class, object, and circle positive controls. Do not branch on fixture names, labels, source-line values, entity counts, coordinates, or diagram dimensions.
